listing.summary: A CN translation and adjustment of Diamond Chip's: Diamond Legacy. This version is a Ship / Weapons & Hullmod pack. It was originally a bounty pack, was unable to effectively translate the Magiclib Bounty Data so it exists in this form as a Ship / Weapons & Hullmod pack.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a large pack of superships, weapons, and hullmods, primarily for pirates and Luddic Path factions.

description: This is a translated and adjusted version of a Chinese mod, converted from a bounty pack into a ship, weapon, and hullmod pack. It introduces numerous superships to pirate factions and some non-lore additions to the Luddic Path, along with a few Persean and Hegemony ships. It also includes dmods that can be added for 0 DP on the refit screen, offering questionable benefits with major downsides.

discordPostHtml:
A CN translation and adjustment of Diamond Chip's: Diamond Legacy. This version is a Ship / Weapons & Hullmod pack. It was originally a bounty pack, was unable to effectively translate the Magiclib Bounty Data so it exists in this form as a Ship / Weapons & Hullmod pack.

  • This is a supership mod pack, very unbalanced
  • Adds a ton of ships to the pirates & some none-lore additions to Luddic Path to give them some love. A few Persean / Hegemony additions too
  • Has dmods that can be added on the refit screen for 0DP, that provide questionable benefits with major downsides

Enjoy!

Original thread: https://www.fossic.org/thread-12826-1-1.html
